research.method: All values come from FIBA's official statistics service behind fiba.basketball (the public data API the site's history pages call). For every team the player list comes from getgdapcompetitionteamstatisticsbyteamid; each player's totals are the sum of his per-game rows from getgdapplayergamestatisticsbyplayerid, restricted to the 60 games of this tournament listed by getgdapgamesbycompetitionid. Birth dates come from getgdapplayerinfobycompetitionid (fallback: the team roster). FIBA records minutes in whole minutes for these events.
research.add_up_check: Each team's summed player points equal the points in its game scores (difference listed per team in team_totals[].check).
research.bbr_matching: bbr_id is set only for keys of library/careers/nba_player_careers.json with an NBA season in 2003-04, 2004-05 or 2005-06, matched by name and then reviewed by hand (birth date and team) for every hand-made match; players whose NBA careers ended before 2003-04 have no careers key and keep bbr_id null (noted on the record).
notes: FIBA's record of this tournament holds only points, free throws made/attempted, personal fouls and appearances per player and game: minutes, field goals, three-pointers, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks and turnovers are zero in every row, i.e. not recorded. They are null here. No other reachable source with complete box totals was found: archive.fiba.com no longer serves the old pages, the Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) is unreachable from this environment, and the asia-basket.com archive shows no per-player tournament table. Appearances may be undercounted for players who scored no points and committed no foul in a game, if FIBA omitted such rows.
